prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, late 30s goddess, curved bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down teal hair — wearing a skin-tight micro summer school uniform set, a cropped short-sleeve button-style shirt of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with a thin sky-blue line at each cuff and a loosened navy tie hanging from an open collar, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro mini skirt of ultra-thin matte pale-blue modal jersey with an open lace-up front, thin ribbon laces criss-crossing over her bare skin from the hem up to the waist, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the loosened navy tie, the sky-blue cuff lines and the ribbon laces, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme curved bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy pale blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a classical Chinese garden with a stone path, a zigzag bridge with a waist-high rail, a moon gate of standard height and a pavilion, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
